resources.string: On your computer, open Codex Desk → Settings → Phone access → Set up phone access. Desk will install and configure the connection for you.
Tailscale is built into Desk. Sign in with the same account as your computer. No separate app or system VPN is needed. Changing Wi-Fi or mobile networks does not change your computer address.
Paste the address shown in computer settings. After connecting, enter the pairing code from that same page.
Sign in to connect this phone.
Your Tailscale administrator needs to approve this phone.
Built-in connection unavailable. Check your internet connection and retry.
Update Android System WebView to use the built-in connection.
Enter the HTTPS .ts.net address shown by Codex Desk.
Could not reach your computer. Keep Desk running on the computer and check Phone access in its settings.
The computer’s HTTPS certificate could not be verified. Open Phone access in desktop settings and retry setup.
No app is available to open this link.
